 ARLINGTON, Texas (WCYB) — Current Dallas Cowboys tight end and former Union High School standout James Mitchell scored his second career touchdown on Sunday. 
 The score came from a Javonte Williams fumble that Mitchell recovered in the endzone to get the Cowboys on the board. 
 The score marks Mitchell's second career touchdown, the first coming in 2022 when the former Bear was with the Detroit Lions. 
 Mitchell was called up from the practice squad ahead of Sunday's matchup.
